description: This repository defines repeatable energy-modelling benchmark cases for JuMP and HiGHS work. Its README lists case scripts for GenX, PowerModels, Sienna and TulipaEnergyModel, with commands for rebuilding optimisation instances and running tests. Users run the supplied scripts with the named model dependencies; outputs are mathematical programming instances and timing results for selected energy cases. Coverage follows the included example grids and systems, not a single country. GitHub metadata and the README state MIT licensing. A limitation is that generated MPS files are normally excluded from Git and must be rebuilt with matching model versions; a benchmark runtime is not a physical validation of any grid result. These cases can test whether energy-infrastructure models and solvers remain computationally tractable. The related catalogue OSeMOSYS model is a separate energy optimiser. No instances, packages or solvers were downloaded or executed.
